title: Domain Pack manifest
description: Declarative manifest for a Domain Pack (pack.toml). A Domain Pack is policy and guidance data, never executable code -- see docs/pack-authoring-guide.md and docs/threat-model.md's pack-extensibility section. Referenced content files (rules.toml, questions.toml, etc.) are separate documents validated in their own right; this schema only validates the manifest itself.

pack_id.description: Stable identifier used in routing.domain_packs[].pack_id, CLI --domain flags, and lock files.

description.description: One or two sentences. Not a place for the full domain guidance -- that belongs in references/.

capabilities.description: Short capability labels (e.g. 'prd-authoring', 'classification-modeling') shown by `pack list`/`pack inspect`. Advisory only -- never mechanically matched against a request.

supported_intents.description: Which Meta-Skill task intents this pack is meant for. Empty means no restriction is declared.

triggers.description: Example natural-language phrases/keywords that suggest this pack. Advisory documentation for the Meta-Skill's model-dependent routing -- never evaluated deterministically by the CLI. See docs/architecture.md's deterministic/model-dependent boundary.

exclusions.description: Negative routing signals: request shapes this pack does NOT fit even though it might look related. Equally advisory.

max_platform_version.description: Inclusive upper bound on groundspec.__about__.PACK_PLATFORM_VERSION, the Domain Pack SDK's own compatibility contract version (decoupled from the CLI's own possibly-prerelease version string). null means no known upper bound.

dependencies.description: Other Domain Packs this one requires to be resolved alongside it.

suggested.description: Pack IDs commonly useful alongside this one. Informational only -- never auto-resolved.

conflicts.description: Packs this one declares itself incompatible with. A conflicting pair can never both be in one resolved selection -- see docs/architecture.md's composition/precedence section.

priority.description: Tie-break dimension (higher wins) used before alphabetical pack_id ordering when two same-layer packs' rules/gates share a conflict key. Does not grant a pack permission to override a higher precedence layer (core invariants, risk overlays, explicit user authorization) -- see docs/architecture.md.

risk_classification.description: 'requires_expert_review' documents that a domain (medical, legal, investment-advice) needs additional expert review and safety process beyond what an ordinary pack provides -- see docs/domain-pack-backlog.md. No such pack ships in this release; the CLI does not yet gate on this value beyond surfacing it, which is disclosed, not hidden.

rules.description: Relative path to a rule-pack file (rule_pack_schema_version 0.1.0 -- the same format core-invariants.json etc. already use). May itself be a pure-import wrapper with no rules of its own.
